widgets_values:
COSPLAYER - fictional character costume.
Mode 'Costume only' (default) sends costume + signature hair/eyes and lets the person randomize; 'Full character' also locks the physique for a faithful look.
random_scope narrows Random picks to a franchise/category/attribute.
Crossplay: set the person's gender independently of the character.
Unmask toggle reveals the head under a full-mask suit.
A named beast (Appa, Toothless...) renders as the animal, not a wearer.

widgets_values:
IDENTITY FORGE - the character engine.
Every field is Random (roll) / a value (lock) / None (omit).
Seed auto-randomizes each queue; set fixed to reproduce.
accessory_density: drop to Minimal/None for clean portraits.
size_scale: manual only (Auto default, never random) - force giant/tiny.
Preset nodes (Cosplayer/Archetype/Creature/Modifier) feed this node's archetype_json; the node CLOSEST to Identity Forge wins on overlap.
Preset modes: Cosplayer 'Full character' vs 'Costume only'; Archetype 'Essentials' (default) vs 'Full preset' - they decide how much of the person is built.

widgets_values:
TURNAROUND - reference sheet (camera only).
Wire Identity Forge's prompt_json in; it emits front / three-quarter / profile / back as a LIST, so one queue renders the whole set of the SAME person.
It only moves the camera - character and scene stay on Identity Forge.
The straight-back view OMITS the face (eyes, lips, makeup, expression) so the model renders a back.
Controls are camera-only: no seed, no re-roll between views.

widgets_values: professional photograph, DSLR quality, sharp focus, natural lighting, high detail skin texture . Cosplaying as Harley Quinn (DC): a 45-year-old Maori woman with an athletic build, average height, and fair skin. She has a moderately fit physique with narrow shoulders, a very small bust, a defined waist, rounded hips, a thick neck, and rigid posture. Her face is diamond with a smooth forehead, softly prominent cheekbones, a square jawline, and a cleft chin. She has bright blue downturned eyes, a slightly crooked nose, slightly full lips, well defined and arched eyebrows, and a toothy grin. Her skin shows a rosy complexion, vitiligo patches, and heavy freckles. Her hair is shoulder length coily platinum blonde, pigtails. She has a side part and subtle balayage highlights. She wears club makeup, colorful bold eyeshadow, dramatic winged eyeliner, dramatic falsies lashes, deep red lip colour, rosy blush, tinted brows, subtle contour, inner corner highlighter, and sun-kissed glow finish. She has tassel earrings, a gemstone pendant, a body chain, a cuff, and black polish nails. She wears a quilted red-and-black leather corset with studded leather straps across the midriff, a short black skirt trimmed with white lace, fingerless gloves, and heavy buckled boots, with high blonde pigtails dyed red on one side and black on the other. She is standing with feet planted wide, holding a candy-striped red-and-white baseball bat resting on one shoulder. Her expression is wide toothy grin, set in a walk-in closet with mirrors, under colored gel lighting, during autumn, the framing is full body shot, straight-on eye level, composed with leading lines drawing the eye to the subject, and with a triumphant mood.
